archetypes.name: dyn-recovery-logs
archetypes.rationale: Recovered stalled summaries now cross normalization, flush, and push boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the recovered-stall reconciliation flow across ship_pr, ship, and run_log_flush. Check that fresh PR creation still avoids a second log flush, while resumed stalled summaries are corrected before success or merge. Verify push failures and strict flush skips cannot report a successful outcome. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
